Q01.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS "value"
FROM "orders"
WHERE ("orders"."order_status" = ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" >= ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" < ?)
LIMIT 1

Q02.sql:
SELECT SUM(order_items.price) AS "value"
FROM "order_items"
  JOIN "orders" ON "order_items"."order_id" = "orders"."order_id"
WHERE ("orders"."order_status" = ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" >= ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" < ?)
LIMIT 1

Q03.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN "orders"."purchase_at" >= ? THEN 'current' WHEN "orders"."purchase_at" >= ? THEN 'baseline' END AS "_period", SUM(order_items.price) AS "_v"
  FROM "order_items"
    JOIN "orders" ON "order_items"."order_id" = "orders"."order_id"
  WHERE ("orders"."order_status" = ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" >= ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" < ?)
  GROUP BY 1
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "_period" = 'current' THEN "_v" END) AS "current", MAX(CASE WHEN "_period" = 'baseline' THEN "_v" END) AS "baseline"
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  "current", "baseline", "current" - "baseline" AS "delta", CASE WHEN "baseline" IS NULL OR "baseline" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ("current" - "baseline") / "baseline" END AS "growth_rate"
FROM pivoted
LIMIT 1

Q04.sql:
SELECT "categories"."category_name_zh" AS "category", SUM(order_items.price) AS "value"
FROM "order_items"
  JOIN "orders" ON "order_items"."order_id" = "orders"."order_id"
  JOIN "products" ON "order_items"."product_id" = "products"."product_id"
  JOIN "categories" ON "products"."category_id" = "categories"."category_id"
WHERE ("orders"."order_status" = ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" >= ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" < ?)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "value" DESC, "category" ASC
LIMIT 10

Q05.sql:
WITH grain AS (
  SELECT "sellers"."seller_name" AS "seller", "orders"."order_id" AS "_key", MAX(CASE WHEN orders.delivered_at > orders.estimated_delivery_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "_num", 1 AS "_den"
  FROM "orders"
    JOIN "order_items" ON "order_items"."order_id" = "orders"."order_id"
    JOIN "sellers" ON "order_items"."seller_id" = "sellers"."seller_id"
  WHERE ("orders"."order_status" = ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" >= ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" < ?)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT "seller", SUM("_num") AS "numerator", SUM("_den") AS "denominator", SUM("_num") / NULLIF(SUM("_den"), 0) AS "value", SUM("_den") AS "order_count"
FROM grain
GROUP BY 1
HAVING "order_count" >= ?
ORDER BY "value" DESC, "seller" ASC
LIMIT 10

Q06.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN orders.delivered_at > orders.estimated_delivery_at THEN '延迟' ELSE '准时' END AS "late", AVG(order_reviews.review_score) AS "value"
FROM "order_reviews"
  JOIN "orders" ON "order_reviews"."order_id" = "orders"."order_id"
WHERE ("orders"."order_status" = ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" >= ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" < ?)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "late" ASC
LIMIT 10

Q07.sql:
WITH entity AS (
  SELECT "customers"."customer_unique_id" AS "_entity", COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS "_n"
  FROM "orders"
    JOIN "customers" ON "orders"."customer_id" = "customers"."customer_id"
  WHERE ("orders"."order_status" = ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" >= ?) AND ("orders"."purchase_at" < ?)
  GROUP BY 1
), filtered AS (
  SELECT "_entity", "_n" FROM entity WHERE "_n" >= ?
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM filtered
LIMIT 1
